brief:
The person tagged the bot in a reply. The post they tagged it in says:
Fix the handle/profile display its currently showing did and the links to each account to Bluesky @buildthis.bisks.net

The thread it's replying to, oldest first (this is the context "this" refers to):
@fromthewestmeadow.com: @buildthis.bisks.net a website that analyzes the likes across all your posts to determine which things each of your moots like, like if account A only likes topic cluster X
note: fixed — profile lookups were capped at 200 likers, so once the "read every liker" fix removed the count cap, everyone past #200 fell back to a bare DID. now it fetches every liker's profile (in parallel batches), so names, avatars, and bsky.app links work for the whole list.
